name: Netmaker Community Edition Self-Hosted WireGuard Network Manager
free_limit: Apache-2.0-licensed open-source Community Edition to self-host WireGuard mesh, remote-access and site-to-site network management; no Netmaker Community software license fee or fixed trial expiration.
